title: Large Language Models Naively Recover Ethnicity from Individual Records

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating and regressing racial misclassification rates against neighborhood-level (ZCTA) median household income to determine if models systematically misclassify individuals (e.g., minorities in wealthier areas) based on local wealth.

Comparing model classification accuracy and recall across diverse self-reported racial, ethnic, caste, and religious categories to identify disparate predictive performance and error rates for minority or marginalized populations.
